question: Do any of the four complete direct-measurement traits show topology-robust phylogenetic retention in the fixed seven-taxon panel?

topology_ensemble.use: first six AU-nonrejected optimized Comp1061 topologies

trait_selection_rule: Include every admitted comparable scalar trait present for all seven taxa; do not select by an observed history result.
primary_estimand: Spearman correlation between patristic distance and absolute trait difference. Positive values indicate phylogenetic retention in this distance diagnostic.

null.scheme: all 7! tip-label permutations separately on each topology and trait

multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across the four fixed traits separately within each topology

decision_rule.trait_supported: observed rho > 0 and positive-tail BH q < 0.05 on every one of the six topologies
decision_rule.panel: supported only if at least one fixed trait passes the trait rule

sensitivities: leave-one-taxon-out rho range on every topology
Pagel lambda MLE as a descriptive small-sample diagnostic only
negative-tail exact p as an overdispersion diagnostic without a convergence claim
stop_rules: STOP if the registry hash differs.
STOP unless exactly the four fixed traits share exactly the seven fixed taxa.
STOP if the AU tree artifact hash differs or fewer than six trees are present.
Do not substitute ranges, calculate range midpoints, add traits or remove taxa after viewing results.
Do not run shared-branch-change or ancestral-state claims from this n=7 panel.
known_design_limit: The seven taxa are clustered by lineage and contributing source study. All results are diagnostic and cannot establish a general East-Asian process.
preexecution_context: An earlier direct PGLS used two of these traits for different orientation/coupling questions. The current history estimand, complete four-trait inclusion rule and exact decision rule were frozen before executing this diagnostic.
claim_boundary: A supported result would show topology-robust retention within this fixed panel only. A failed result would mean retention was not detected, not that a trait is evolutionarily independent or labile. Neither outcome establishes convergence, adaptation, function, absolute rate or event causation.
